name: Motorcycle Simulator Florida
summary:
Ride Miami from the seat - alone, or with up to three friends.

29 KM OF REAL MIAMI
The Dolphin Expressway into downtown, I-395 past the Kaseya Center, the MacArthur Causeway past the cruise ships at PortMiami, Alton Road through Miami Beach and the Julia Tuttle Causeway over Biscayne Bay.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
